# Preface {.unnumbered}

Welcome to the British Red Cross's State of the Nation for the UK's asylum system. This website brings together the latest data on the asylum and modern slavery systems in the UK. It covers who is claiming asylum in the UK, how they are arriving, how they are being supported while they wait for a decision and who is being granted protection. It also presents data on survivors of modern slavery in the UK.

To help separate fact from fiction, the State of the Nation tool visualising data, ensures that up-to-date facts and figures on the UK asylum system are easily accessible to everyone.
